envelope.description: Bind a review attempt to a task at admission

body.title: Bind a review attempt to a task at admission
body.summary: AMENDED (rev 2, user-approved option b): at review admission in ReviewWorkers (admit/admitOwned, which already receive the TrustedRpcContext), call the daemon-internal s1 seam ProgressAccess.launchReview for the review — the pre-check proved no review admission carries a chat origin bound to its connection, so launchReview mints authorization with origin { turnId: reviewId } without requiring one; no IPC method exposes it — and register the matching delegate through the review producer, fire-and-forget guarded. A session connection, an aborted connection, a session-memory execution, a refused launch or a refused registration has no task and behaves exactly as today. s3 supplies only the review identity and delegates; minting and fencing stay in s1.
acceptanceChecks: the admission call path is documented in the build record: which requests carry a bound origin (finding: none — review-service.ts:128/192 -> context(trusted) -> ReviewWorkers.admit/admitOwned carry only connectionIdentity/daemonEpoch/connectionSignal; the only origin-bound launch is executor-relay.ts:245 on executor connections)

an observed review (any non-session, non-aborted admission) is registered as a task of kind design-review or code-review via the daemon-internal launchReview seam (access.ts) minting origin { turnId: reviewId }
an unobserved review (session connection, aborted connection, session-memory execution, refused launch or refused registration) is admitted exactly as before with no task
a failure or stall of launch or register never fails or slows the review admission
no minting or fencing logic is added outside s1's access and coordinator

src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-task-binding.test.ts: a review without an origin, session or capacity is admitted exactly as before
src/daemon/threads/__tests__/review-task-binding.test.ts: a failure to launch or register never fails or slows the review
